title: Energy Assistance Pledge, Medical Certificate and Counseling Qualifiers of the Payment Arrangements Tiers
content:
*Energy assistance liaison note — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)*

Two tiers of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements) rest on a household circumstance recorded on the service account. The Extended Hardship Payment Agreement requires an energy assistance pledge recorded on the service account within a lookback of calendar days before the offer, and it carries a referral to the energy assistance counseling line with the offer. The Medical Certificate Payment Agreement requires the service account to be under unexpired medical certificate protection. No other tier carries any of these requirements.

| Tier | Energy assistance pledge required | Pledge lookback before the offer | Unexpired medical certificate required | Counseling line referral with the offer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | no | 90 calendar days | no | no |
| Extended Hardship Payment Agreement | yes | 90 calendar days | no | yes |
| Winter Protection Payment Agreement | no | 90 calendar days | no | no |
| Medical Certificate Payment Agreement | no | 90 calendar days | yes | no |
| Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | no | 90 calendar days | no | no |
| Commercial Installment Agreement | no | 90 calendar days | no | no |

**What each column means**

- *Energy assistance pledge required*: whether an energy assistance pledge must have been recorded on the service account before the tier may be offered.
- *Pledge lookback*: the number of calendar days before the offer within which that pledge must have been recorded. Every tier carries the same 90-day lookback; it decides an offer only on the tier that requires a pledge.
- *Unexpired medical certificate required*: whether the service account must be under unexpired medical certificate protection.
- *Counseling line referral*: whether the member must be given the energy assistance counseling line when the agreement is offered.

**Liaison questions answered**

*A household's only pledge was recorded long before the offer. Does it qualify the account for the Extended Hardship Payment Agreement?* Only a pledge recorded within the 90 calendar days before the offer meets the Extended Hardship requirement.

*Is a counseling referral given with a Medical Certificate Payment Agreement offer?* No. On this table the referral is carried only by the Extended Hardship Payment Agreement.
